name: account-switch
description: Switch Claude Code between saved claude.ai logins (Pro, Team, Max), globally or per session, with a live /model list for the active account.

auto_sync_models.title: Sync /model list at session start
auto_sync_models.description: Rewrite the modelPicker key in settings.json from Anthropic's live model list for the active account. A one-time backup is kept as settings.json.ccsw-bak.

extra_models_url.title: Extra models URL (optional)
extra_models_url.description: An OpenAI-style /v1/models URL whose models are appended to the picker, for example a local gateway. Leave empty for none.

extra_models_owners.title: Extra models owner filter (optional)
extra_models_owners.description: Comma-separated owned_by values to keep from the extra models URL. Empty keeps every model.
